_about: A made-up employee IT service desk for a fictional retail company with stores and a corporate office. Each topic lists the steps that actually close its tickets (true_steps), what the current knowledge base article says (article_steps, null when there is no article), which notes the missing steps show up in (provider or internal), how often a ticket needs an extra one-off step (variant_rate), and its share of ticket volume (weight). Nothing here describes a real company. About 30% of tickets fall outside the named topics (one-off issues); they are counted in volume but never drafted.

steps.verify_identity: Verify the associate's identity with employee ID and store number
steps.reset_password_portal: Reset the password in the self-service portal
steps.unlock_account: Unlock the account in the directory
steps.tell_sync_wait: Tell the associate to wait 15 minutes for the store devices to sync
steps.old_sms_reset: Send a reset code by SMS from the old reset tool
steps.send_mfa_link: Send a new authenticator enrollment link
steps.confirm_mfa_signin: Confirm a test sign-in with the new phone
steps.check_schedule_license: Check the associate has a scheduling app license
steps.clear_app_cache: Clear the scheduling app cache on the phone
steps.relink_store_id: Relink the associate to their home store ID
steps.manager_approval: Ask the store manager to approve the missed punch
steps.add_punch_wfm: Add the punch in the workforce system
steps.repair_bluetooth: Remove and re-pair the scanner in Bluetooth settings
steps.reset_scanner_profile: Reset the scanner to the store profile by scanning the setup barcode
steps.swap_scanner_provider: Log a hardware swap with the device provider
steps.readd_printer_queue: Remove and re-add the printer in the store queue
steps.check_printer_ip: Confirm the printer kept its reserved IP address
steps.check_ap_status: Check the store access point status in the network console
steps.forget_network: Forget and rejoin the store Wi-Fi on the device
steps.provider_circuit_ticket: Open a circuit ticket with the network provider
steps.check_hr_start_date: Check the start date in the HR system
steps.trigger_provisioning: Re-run account provisioning for the new hire
steps.assign_store_group: Add the account to the store's access group
steps.check_mailbox_owner: Confirm the mailbox owner approved access
steps.grant_mailbox: Grant access to the shared mailbox
steps.tell_restart_outlook: Tell the user to restart Outlook to see the mailbox
steps.check_vpn_group: Confirm the user is in the VPN access group
steps.old_vpn_client: Restart the legacy VPN client service
steps.enroll_mdm: Enroll the phone in device management
steps.add_mail_profile: Add the work mail profile from the company portal app
steps.check_os_version: Confirm the phone meets the minimum OS version
steps.check_audio_device: Check the selected audio device in Teams
steps.reimage_laptop: Book a reimage with desktop support
steps.escalate_payroll: Send the punch to payroll because the pay period has closed
steps.reregister_device: Re-register a phone that was enrolled under an old account
steps.printer_provider_swap: Log a printer swap with the device provider
steps.hr_record_fix: Ask HR to correct the new hire's job code
